card.name: The digit 1 after Grade
card.fires_on: The digit "1" right after the word Grade in adverse-event severity grading, and sometimes a leading "1" in other numbers or ranges such as "0.8 to 1" or "1 0".

modes.label: Grade 1 severity
modes.description: The number 1 following "Grade" in toxicity or adverse-reaction grading, often as a start of a range like 1-2.

modes.label: Other leading 1
modes.description: A "1" starting a number or range outside of grading, such as the end of an Rf range or an EV number.
